The concrete hostname, resolved address, local endpoint, and external peer behavior remain runtime instance data not recoverable statically.
The symbolic transport semantics represented by socket type 1 and protocol 17 are not established beyond their exact numeric arguments.

analyses.summary: The reachable ntpclient path resolves a runtime hostname, creates a socket, constructs either an IPv4 or IPv6 destination with port 123, and calls connect. Resolver or connect failure returns to main, which closes the descriptor and skips primary_loop; preliminary getaddrinfo or socket failure exits.

evidence.claim: main calls getaddrinfo(name, 0, req, pai); a nonzero result reaches exit(1), while success supplies the family used for socket creation and the IPv4-versus-IPv6 selector.
main creates v23 with socket(v21, 1, 17), checks for -1, and calls perror followed by exit(1) on failure.
The target-reachable main path calls setup_transmit(v23, name, 0x7B, v22); a nonzero return closes v23 and skips primary_loop.

For v22 == 4, setup_transmit sets sockaddr family 2, calls stuff_net_addr, writes the supplied port, and reaches the IPv4 connect call. The assembly confirms the helper call at 0x401bdc and connect at 0x401c18.
The seed call invokes gethostbyname(a2); a successful hostent with h_length 4 supplies the first IPv4 address, while NULL or an unexpected length returns 1.
The IPv4 connect call uses fd, the constructed sockaddr, and length 0x10; -1 causes perror and return 1. The assembly confirms the call at 0x401c18.
For the alternate branch, setup_transmit sets sockaddr family 10, calls stuff_net_addr6, writes the supplied port, and reaches the IPv6 connect call.
stuff_net_addr6 calls gethostbyname2(a2, 10) and copies four address words; NULL causes herror and return 1. The assembly confirms AF_INET6 argument 10 at 0x4019fc.
The IPv6 connect call uses fd, the constructed sockaddr, and length 0x1C; -1 causes perror and return 1. The assembly confirms the call at 0x401ca0.

main invokes setup_receive on the same descriptor before setup_transmit; that local bind/listen lifecycle is independent of the seeded outbound resolution/connect calls and has no catalog callsite in this wave.
